subject.title: Interactive parity with the Codex runtime: ask-user-question · plan mode · goal mode — the roadmap

question: Should OpenClaw accept Codex-style structured questions, plan mode, and unattended goal continuation as core runtime behavior now, and should the paired implementation land as one branch or be split?
rationale: The request changes core agent runtime, gateway/protocol APIs, UI, channel delivery, default tool exposure, and a security-sensitive goal continuation loop, so automation cannot infer the intended product and rollout shape.

options.title: Stage the feature groups
options.body: Keep this hub open while maintainers review questions, plan mode, and goal continuation as separate staged changes with focused proof.

options.title: Sponsor the broad branch
options.body: Explicitly accept the review and rollout cost of landing the paired implementation as one feature bundle after blockers are resolved.

options.title: Defer or narrow
options.body: Reject or narrow the roadmap if these primitives should wait or move behind a smaller API or plugin design first.

recommendation.title: Stage the feature groups
recommendation.body: Keep this hub open while maintainers review questions, plan mode, and goal continuation as separate staged changes with focused proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the clearest history on update_plan and strict-agentic policy, which are central to the requested rollout.
